subject: equations underlaying the predict command in laavan

messages.author: a0ec8e0cf19a05fe
messages.subject: equations underlaying the predict command in laavan
parts:
Hello.  One can obtain predicted values of latent variables in Laavan via the predict() function.  However, historically there have been different ways of estimating the values of a latent given observed variables.  Can someone point me to documentation or references that explain how this is done in Laavan?
